# Windows AD Self DACL Assignment

**Type:** TTP

**Author:** Dean Luxton

**Upstream version:** 7

## Description

Detect when a user creates a new DACL in AD for their own AD object.

## MITRE ATT&CK

| ID | Technique | Tactics |
|---|---|---|
| [T1484](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1484/) | Domain or Tenant Policy Modification | privilege-escalation, defense-evasion |
| [T1098](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1098/) | Account Manipulation | persistence, privilege-escalation |

## Analytic Stories

- Sneaky Active Directory Persistence Tricks
